The tale: A monk at Tōdai-ji was told by a physiognomist (相術師) that he would not live past 40. So he left Tōdai-ji, went to Kasagi (笠置) and engaged in harsh asceticism. This is Jōkei (貞慶, 1155–1213), also known as Gedatsu Shōnin (解脱上人). He was a monk of the Hossō sect at Kōfuku-ji / Tōdai-ji. He was told he wouldn't live long, so he retreated to Kasagiyama and practiced. Actually the story: 貞慶 was told by a fortune-teller he'd die young, discouraged, he went to Kasagidera. Hmm.
